tagline: Every throw. Every rival. Every result.
description:
Score Arena turns a phone into a shared scorekeeper for games played around a real table or dartboard. Start a room with Game Hub profiles, choose the order, enter every throw and keep the complete result in each player's history.

The first release includes regulation Darts 501 with double-out and checkout suggestions, plus Cricket with marks, open numbers and proper scoring. The dartboard input is shared by both modes and ready for more darts games later.
capabilities: Darts 501 with bust rules, double-out and checkout suggestions.
Cricket for two to eight players with marks and open-target scoring.
Best-of match lengths and a complete turn history.
Responsive dartboard designed for phones and larger screens.
Profile results, wins, losses and head-to-head history through Game Hub.

integrations.name: Game Hub
integrations.summary: Players use their Game Hub profiles and finished matches are recorded in profile statistics and head-to-head history.
